subject.title: [security] Coordinator diagnostics do not redact GCP signed query credentials

question: Should Crabbox patch the Worker GCP signed-query redaction gap now and treat it as security-sensitive release work?
rationale: Source inspection supports the gap, but the affected behavior is Crabbox's documented credential-redaction boundary and should be confirmed by maintainers before repair automation proceeds.
